---
title: "Library"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Import the book catalog
books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Sort books by reading status and dates
# --------------------------------------------------

books <- books |>
  mutate(
    date_started = as.Date(date_started),
    date_finished = as.Date(date_finished),

    # Unfinished books appear before finished books
    unfinished = status != "Finished",

    # Use the relevant date for each book
    sorting_date = if_else(
      unfinished,
      date_started,
      date_finished
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(unfinished),
    desc(sorting_date)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare clickable book titles
# --------------------------------------------------

library_table <- books |>
  mutate(
    title_link = map2_chr(
      title,
      book_page,
      function(book_title, page) {

        if (is.na(page) || page == "") {
          return(as.character(
            htmltools::htmlEscape(book_title)
          ))
        }

        # Convert the Quarto source path to its HTML path
        page_url <- str_replace(
          page,
          "\\.qmd$",
          ".html"
        )

        as.character(
          htmltools::tags$a(
            href = page_url,
            book_title
          )
        )
      }
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Title = title_link,
    Author = author,
    Pages = total_pages,
    Status = status,
    `Date Started` = as.character(date_started),
    `Date Finished` = as.character(date_finished)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Display the interactive library
# --------------------------------------------------

DT::datatable(
  library_table,

  rownames = FALSE,

  # Allow HTML links in the Title column
  escape = 2:6,

  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    order = list(),
    autoWidth = TRUE
  ),

  filter = "none"
)
```
